The '''''Dodger''''' was a [[EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate/Legends|Nebulon-B frigate]] used by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]]. The ship arrived to attack 3 [[BFF-1 bulk freighter/Legends|BFF-1 bulk freighters]] ''[[Rugle]]'' with multiple Rebel starfighters. The attack was thwarted by two [[Alpha-class Xg-1 Star Wing/Legends|Assault Gunboats]]. The attack was recorded and used in the [[Combat chamber]] to train future pilots on the Gunboat. One of them was [[Maarek Stele/Legends|Maarek Stele]].

==Behind the scenes==
The frigate appears on the [[1994]] game [[Star Wars: TIE Fighter (video game)|Star Wars: TIE Fighter]] in the [[Combat chamber]] Mission 4 training mission. As the mission in question is based on historical events, it is unclear what happened to the ''Dodger'' outside the Combat chamber.

The frigate can be destroyed by the player as part of one of two "Bonus objectives", the other is the destruction of the Shuttle [[Leap]].
